mechanism.claim: An unusually active completed BITO cash session transfers directional bitcoin-futures sponsorship into the continuously traded BTC market after US cash close. In elevated prior BTC variation, follow the sign of the completed BITO raw open-to-close return for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long for positive BITO raw cash-session return; short for negative return
mechanism.why_distinct: BITO relative share-volume sponsorship is direct listed bitcoin-futures participation. It is not ETF range close-location, an equity-sector pair, a generic BTC price-volume indicator, opening gap, funding, OI, basis, prior event artifact, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both BITO relative share volume and preceding twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must rank in their causal upper 35%, selecting July-like high-participation stress or expansion states
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse external US-listed bitcoin-futures fund cash-close clock and its causal relative-volume state are absent from Gross9

features.source: candidate-specific Yahoo chart raw unadjusted BITO regular-session daily open/close/volume snapshot downloaded only after preregistration push
features.session: US trading date D with finite positive raw open and close and finite positive raw share volume
features.cash_return: log(raw close/raw open); zero is ineligible
features.availability: D 23:00 UTC, safely after the 16:00 America/New_York regular close in EST and EDT
features.relative_volume_rank: strict-prior midrank of raw BITO share volume over at most 270 prior valid sessions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT five-minute open-to-close log returns over the prior 24 elapsed hours ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 previous valid daily 23:00 UTC states, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: each valid BITO regular-session date D at 23:00 UTC
clock.side: sign of completed raw BITO cash-session return
clock.reservation: chronological global half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.bito: Yahoo chart query1=2022-09-01 query2=2026-08-02 exclusive interval=1d events=history; raw open/close/volume only
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent direct bitcoin-futures ETF participation-transfer channel plus requested high BTC variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no listed-fund substitution, adjusted-price use, volume-rank, variation, side, session, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.definition: ProShares states BITO targets bitcoin performance through futures and swaps and does not invest directly in bitcoin
external_basis.selection_use: official futures-linked exposure only; no BITO candidate incidence or economic outcomes
